name: Griffith International Academic Merit Scholarship
summary: Automatic 20% tuition fee reduction for international students with strong grades starting undergraduate or postgraduate coursework at Griffith.
key: Eligible international students receive 20% off their tuition fees for the entire duration of their program.
who: Citizen of a country other than Australia or New Zealand
Minimum GPA of 4.5 on a 7 point scale or equivalent in previous studies
Full-time study; meet academic and English entry requirements
Some programs excluded, including the MBA and Doctor of Medicine
how: No separate application: apply for a Griffith program and eligibility is assessed with your offer
catches: Must commence in Trimester 3 2025 or any trimester in 2026 or 2027; deferring to 2028 or later is not eligible
